stop_rule: One attempt per planned trial; preserve failed or incomplete outputs; no replacement or output repairs by integrator
normative_rule: No approve command, no synthetic signature, no field action; require a pending normative node and an engineering intervention requirement that depends on it; preserve pending status and blocked engineering gates
normative_audit: Verify existence, transitive link, pending status and blocked engineering phase for every trial; a missing link is an observed failed control, never success
release_rule: Freeze visible package, source hashes, harness, instructions and rubric in a local commit before starting any trial
